result.question: Quais procedimentos, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% do total de atendimentos realizados?
result.gold_sql: SELECT nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_procedimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM internacao_procedimento a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_procedimentos DESC;
result.generated_sql: WITH procedimento_counts AS ( SELECT p."NOME_PROC", COUNT(*) AS total_ocorrencias FROM internacao_procedimento ip JOIN procedimentos p ON ip."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ), procedimento_acumulado AS ( SELECT "NOME_PROC", total_ocorrencias, SUM(total_ocorrencias) OVER (ORDER BY total_ocorrencias DESC) AS total_acumulado, SUM(total_ocorrencias) OVER () AS total_geral FROM procedimento_counts ) SELECT "NOME_PROC" FROM procedimento_acumulado WHERE (total_acumulado * 100.0 / total_geral) <= 80 ORDER BY total_ocorrencias DESC;
